# Phone-only supplemental hosts entries, appended to the canonical hosts file
# generated by ~/hosts-blocker during deploy staging.
#
# Why here and not in hosts-blocker: that generator is shared with the PC,
# where the Play Store does not exist and these lines would be dead weight.
# This file is the phone's own layer, which is what "all phone changes in one
# repo" means. It follows the same precedent as strip_workout_hosts.py, which
# already post-processes the generated canonical for phone-specific reasons.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google Play Store (com.android.vending) -- APK DELIVERY ONLY.
#
# The package is already hidden by the app sweep; this layer only covers the
# window where it gets re-enabled. That makes a too-narrow list nearly free
# and a too-wide list expensive, so this names APK download/licensing hosts
# and NOTHING that com.google.android.gms uses for push registration or the
# persistent push channel.
#
# DO NOT ADD, under any circumstances:
#   mtalk.google.com          - the FCM persistent connection
#   fcm.googleapis.com        - FCM send/registration
#   android.googleapis.com    - GMS checkin/registration
#   *.googleapis.com wholesale
# infakt's browser-login approval tap arrives over that channel, and infakt is
# the one app this whole policy is built around not breaking. If Play still
# downloads after this list, widen it with more delivery hosts -- never by
# removing a line from the do-not-add set above.
# See docs/DOCS-policy-lists.md#why-the-play-store-is-blocked
0.0.0.0 play.googleapis.com
0.0.0.0 android.clients.google.com
0.0.0.0 play-fe.googleapis.com
0.0.0.0 play-lh.googleusercontent.com
